name: Mutation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests and lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
            "$dir/vendor/bin/infection" --version
          done

      - name: Mutation testing in each package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            (
              cd "$dir"
              php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection \
                --configuration=infection.json5 \
                --with-uncovered \
                --threads=max \
                --only-covering-test-cases \
                --min-msi=0 \
                --min-covered-msi=0 \
                --no-progress \
                --logger-github
            )
          done

      - name: Reject skipped mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            foreach (glob("packages/*/build/infection/infection.json") as $path) {
                $report = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                    fwrite(STDERR, $path . " skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                    exit(1);
                }
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            const reports = fs.readdirSync('packages').flatMap(name => {
              const file = path.join('packages', name, 'build/infection/infection.json');
              if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
              return [{ name, stats: JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).stats }];
            });
            if (reports.length === 0) {
              throw new Error('Infection did not write a package report.');
            }
            for (const report of reports) {
              for (const value of [report.stats.msi, report.stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
                if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                  throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
                }
              }
            }
            const below = reports.filter(report => report.stats.msi < minMsi || report.stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi);
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = `<!-- ${context.workflow}:msi -->`;
            const title = `[${context.workflow}] Mutation score below threshold`;
            const rows = reports.map(report => `| ${report.name} | ${report.stats.msi}% | ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`);
            const body = [
              marker,
              `Scheduled mutation testing on the default branch is below the required score.`,
              '',
              '| Package | MSI | Covered MSI | Required MSI | Required covered MSI |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |',
              ...rows,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              'The score is reported here without failing the workflow. Read packages/*/build/infection/escaped.log in the run artifact for the mutants no test objected to.'
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading(`Mutation testing: ${context.workflow}`)
              .addRaw(reports.map(report => `${report.name}: MSI ${report.stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%), covered MSI ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`).join(' '))
              .write();
            if (below.length === 0) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }

      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: mutation-reports
          path: packages/*/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
name: Renovate lock files

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - packages/*/composer.json
      - packages/*/composer.lock

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: renovate-lockfiles-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  refresh:
    name: Refresh the PHP compatibility lock files
    if: >-
      (github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'renovate[bot]' ||
       github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'mend-for-github-com[bot]') &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.head_ref, 'renovate/') &&
      github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the Renovate revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: none

      - name: Resolve dependencies for each supported PHP version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Global platform overrides preserve each manifest's content hash.
          # No packages are installed and no repository or dependency scripts run.
          originals=()
          for dir in packages/*; do
            original="$(mktemp)"
            cp "$dir/composer.lock" "${original}"
            originals+=("${dir}|${original}")
          done
          restore_locks() {
            local entry dir original
            for entry in "${originals[@]}"; do
              dir="${entry%%|*}"
              original="${entry#*|}"
              cp "${original}" "$dir/composer.lock"
              rm -f "${original}"
            done
          }
          trap restore_locks EXIT

          for php_version in 8.0 8.1 8.2 8.3 8.4; do
            composer --no-plugins config --global platform.php "${php_version}.0"
            for dir in packages/*; do
              cp "$dir/composer.lock.php-${php_version}" "$dir/composer.lock"
              composer update --no-install --no-scripts --no-plugins --prefer-dist --working-dir="$dir"
              composer validate --strict --no-check-publish --working-dir="$dir"
              cp "$dir/composer.lock" "$dir/composer.lock.php-${php_version}"
            done
          done

      - name: Commit the lock files and run CI on the new revision
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git add packages/*/composer.lock.php-*
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'The compatibility lock files are already current.'
            exit 0
          fi

          current_pr="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
          if [ "$(jq -r '.state' <<< "${current_pr}")" != 'open' ] ||
             [ "$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<< "${current_pr}")" != "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ]; then
            echo 'The PR changed while dependencies were resolving; leaving the new revision untouched.'
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message 'chore(deps): refresh PHP compatibility lock files'
          git push origin "HEAD:${HEAD_BRANCH}"

          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not start CI automatically. Dispatch explicitly
          # so Renovate sees checks for the commit containing the refreshed locks.
          gh workflow run ci.yml --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
            --ref "${HEAD_BRANCH}"

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Tests on PHP ${{ matrix.php }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
          - '8.0'
          - '8.1'
          - '8.2'
          - '8.3'
          - '8.4'
          - '8.5'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd, dom
          coverage: none

      - name: Select the matching lock file
        if: matrix.php != '8.5'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            cp "$dir/composer.lock.php-${{ matrix.php }}" "$dir/composer.lock"
          done

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests against their lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
          done

      - name: Run the tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" test
          done

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, gd, dom
          coverage: none

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests against their lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
          done

      - name: Check the formatting
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" format:check
          done

      - name: Analyse with PHPStan
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" phpstan
          done

      - name: Check PHP compatibility
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" compat
          done

      - name: Check all guard policies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" guard
          done

      - name: Check the architecture layers
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" deptrac
          done
name: Mutation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests and lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
            "$dir/vendor/bin/infection" --version
          done

      - name: Mutation testing in each package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            (
              cd "$dir"
              php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection \
                --configuration=infection.json5 \
                --with-uncovered \
                --threads=max \
                --only-covering-test-cases \
                --min-msi=0 \
                --min-covered-msi=0 \
                --no-progress \
                --logger-github
            )
          done

      - name: Reject skipped mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            foreach (glob("packages/*/build/infection/infection.json") as $path) {
                $report = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                    fwrite(STDERR, $path . " skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                    exit(1);
                }
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            const reports = fs.readdirSync('packages').flatMap(name => {
              const file = path.join('packages', name, 'build/infection/infection.json');
              if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
              return [{ name, stats: JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).stats }];
            });
            if (reports.length === 0) {
              throw new Error('Infection did not write a package report.');
            }
            for (const report of reports) {
              for (const value of [report.stats.msi, report.stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
                if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                  throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
                }
              }

        with:

          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd, dom

          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
          done

      - name: Check the formatting
        run: |

          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" format:check

          for dir in packages/*; do

name: Mutation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests and lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
            "$dir/vendor/bin/infection" --version
          done

      - name: Mutation testing in each package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            (
              cd "$dir"
              php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection \
                --configuration=infection.json5 \
                --with-uncovered \
                --threads=max \
                --only-covering-test-cases \
                --min-msi=0 \
                --min-covered-msi=0 \
                --no-progress \
                --logger-github
            )
          done

      - name: Reject skipped mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            foreach (glob("packages/*/build/infection/infection.json") as $path) {
                $report = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                    fwrite(STDERR, $path . " skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                    exit(1);
                }
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            const reports = fs.readdirSync('packages').flatMap(name => {
              const file = path.join('packages', name, 'build/infection/infection.json');
              if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
              return [{ name, stats: JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).stats }];
            });
            if (reports.length === 0) {
              throw new Error('Infection did not write a package report.');
            }
            for (const report of reports) {
              for (const value of [report.stats.msi, report.stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
                if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                  throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
                }
              }
            }
            const below = reports.filter(report => report.stats.msi < minMsi || report.stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi);
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = `<!-- ${context.workflow}:msi -->`;
            const title = `[${context.workflow}] Mutation score below threshold`;
            const rows = reports.map(report => `| ${report.name} | ${report.stats.msi}% | ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`);
            const body = [
              marker,
              `Scheduled mutation testing on the default branch is below the required score.`,
              '',
              '| Package | MSI | Covered MSI | Required MSI | Required covered MSI |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |',
              ...rows,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              'The score is reported here without failing the workflow. Read packages/*/build/infection/escaped.log in the run artifact for the mutants no test objected to.'
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading(`Mutation testing: ${context.workflow}`)
              .addRaw(reports.map(report => `${report.name}: MSI ${report.stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%), covered MSI ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`).join(' '))
              .write();
            if (below.length === 0) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }

      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: mutation-reports
          path: packages/*/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Mutation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '41 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  mutation:
    name: Mutation testing
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov
          ini-values: memory_limit=1G

      - name: Validate the Composer manifests and lock files
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer validate --working-dir="$dir" --strict --no-check-publish
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
            "$dir/vendor/bin/infection" --version
          done

      - name: Mutation testing in each package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            (
              cd "$dir"
              php -d memory_limit=4G vendor/bin/infection \
                --configuration=infection.json5 \
                --with-uncovered \
                --threads=max \
                --only-covering-test-cases \
                --min-msi=0 \
                --min-covered-msi=0 \
                --no-progress \
                --logger-github
            )
          done

      - name: Reject skipped mutants
        run: |
          php -d memory_limit=1G -r '
            foreach (glob("packages/*/build/infection/infection.json") as $path) {
                $report = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (($report["stats"]["skippedCount"] ?? null) !== 0) {
                    fwrite(STDERR, $path . " skipped mutants before execution; review the timeout against test durations.\n");
                    exit(1);
                }
            }
          '

      - name: Create or update the mutation score issue
        if: success()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/github-script@ed597411d8f924073f98dfc5c65a23a2325f34cd
        env:
          MIN_MSI: '80'
          MIN_COVERED_MSI: '80'
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');
            const minMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_MSI);
            const minCoveredMsi = Number(process.env.MIN_COVERED_MSI);
            const reports = fs.readdirSync('packages').flatMap(name => {
              const file = path.join('packages', name, 'build/infection/infection.json');
              if (!fs.existsSync(file)) return [];
              return [{ name, stats: JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')).stats }];
            });
            if (reports.length === 0) {
              throw new Error('Infection did not write a package report.');
            }
            for (const report of reports) {
              for (const value of [report.stats.msi, report.stats.coveredCodeMsi, minMsi, minCoveredMsi]) {
                if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value > 100) {
                  throw new Error('Infection must report valid MSI percentages and thresholds.');
                }
              }
            }
            const below = reports.filter(report => report.stats.msi < minMsi || report.stats.coveredCodeMsi < minCoveredMsi);
            const run = `${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const marker = `<!-- ${context.workflow}:msi -->`;
            const title = `[${context.workflow}] Mutation score below threshold`;
            const rows = reports.map(report => `| ${report.name} | ${report.stats.msi}% | ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% | ${minMsi}% | ${minCoveredMsi}% |`);
            const body = [
              marker,
              `Scheduled mutation testing on the default branch is below the required score.`,
              '',
              '| Package | MSI | Covered MSI | Required MSI | Required covered MSI |',
              '| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |',
              ...rows,
              '',
              `Commit: ${context.sha}`,
              `Run and mutation reports: ${run}`,
              `Run attempt: ${process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}`,
              '',
              'The score is reported here without failing the workflow. Read packages/*/build/infection/escaped.log in the run artifact for the mutants no test objected to.'
            ].join('\n');
            await core.summary
              .addHeading(`Mutation testing: ${context.workflow}`)
              .addRaw(reports.map(report => `${report.name}: MSI ${report.stats.msi}% (required: ${minMsi}%), covered MSI ${report.stats.coveredCodeMsi}% (required: ${minCoveredMsi}%).`).join(' '))
              .write();
            if (below.length === 0) return;
            const issues = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listForRepo, {
              ...context.repo, state: 'all', per_page: 100
            });
            const existing = issues.find(issue => !issue.pull_request && (
              issue.body?.includes(marker) || issue.title === title
            ));
            if (existing) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({ ...context.repo, issue_number: existing.number, body });
            } else {
              await github.rest.issues.create({ ...context.repo, title, body });
            }

      - name: Upload mutation reports
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: mutation-reports
          path: packages/*/build/infection/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: Renovate lock files

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - packages/*/composer.json
      - packages/*/composer.lock

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: renovate-lockfiles-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  refresh:
    name: Refresh the PHP compatibility lock files
    if: >-
      (github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'renovate[bot]' ||
       github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'mend-for-github-com[bot]') &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.head_ref, 'renovate/') &&
      github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Check out the Renovate revision
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: none

      - name: Resolve dependencies for each supported PHP version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Global platform overrides preserve each manifest's content hash.
          # No packages are installed and no repository or dependency scripts run.
          originals=()
          for dir in packages/*; do
            original="$(mktemp)"
            cp "$dir/composer.lock" "${original}"
            originals+=("${dir}|${original}")
          done
          restore_locks() {
            local entry dir original
            for entry in "${originals[@]}"; do

          set -euo pipefail

          # Global platform overrides preserve each manifest's content hash.
          # No packages are installed and no repository or dependency scripts run.
          originals=()
          for dir in packages/*; do
            original="$(mktemp)"
            cp "$dir/composer.lock" "${original}"
            originals+=("${dir}|${original}")
          done
          restore_locks() {
            local entry dir original
            for entry in "${originals[@]}"; do
              dir="${entry%%|*}"
              original="${entry#*|}"
              cp "${original}" "$dir/composer.lock"
              rm -f "${original}"
            done
          }
          trap restore_locks EXIT

          for php_version in 8.0 8.1 8.2 8.3 8.4; do
            composer --no-plugins config --global platform.php "${php_version}.0"
            for dir in packages/*; do
              cp "$dir/composer.lock.php-${php_version}" "$dir/composer.lock"
              composer update --no-install --no-scripts --no-plugins --prefer-dist --working-dir="$dir"
              composer validate --strict --no-check-publish --working-dir="$dir"
              cp "$dir/composer.lock" "$dir/composer.lock.php-${php_version}"
            done
          done

      - name: Commit the lock files and run CI on the new revision
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          git add packages/*/composer.lock.php-*
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'The compatibility lock files are already current.'
            exit 0
          fi

          current_pr="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
          if [ "$(jq -r '.state' <<< "${current_pr}")" != 'open' ] ||
             [ "$(jq -r '.head.sha' <<< "${current_pr}")" != "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ]; then
            echo 'The PR changed while dependencies were resolving; leaving the new revision untouched.'
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message 'chore(deps): refresh PHP compatibility lock files'
          git push origin "HEAD:${HEAD_BRANCH}"

          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not start CI automatically. Dispatch explicitly
          # so Renovate sees checks for the commit containing the refreshed locks.
          gh workflow run ci.yml --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
            --ref "${HEAD_BRANCH}"

L172:   * `threads` - the number of threads to use by the runner when executing the mutations. Use “max” to auto calculate it.
L173:   * `logs`
L174:     * `text` - human-readable text log file. Must see to understand what is going on during mutation process.
L175:     * `html` - human-readable report, similar to PHPUnit HTML report. Based on cite37†Stryker Elements†stryker-mutator.io . Here is cite38†an example for Infection itself. If you want to store HTML report in the cloud (useful for OSS projects), see cite19†Stryker Dashboard integration.
L176:     * `summary` - summary log file, which will only display the amount of mutants per category, (Killed, Errored, Escaped, Timed Out, cite39†Skipped , and Not Covered)
L177:     * `json` - machine-readable file in JSON format. Can be programmatically analyzed. In addition to general stats, contains original, mutated code, diff and test framework output for each Mutant.
L178:     * `perMutator` - a markdown file which will give a break-down of the effectiveness of each mutator.
L179: Each of the above logs accept a local filename to write to (eg `infection.log`), or you can write to a PHP stream using `php://stdout`, `php://stderr`, or `php://output`. This can be useful in CI to store the mutation results in the output, or in same-process PHP wrappers to capture the output with output buffering.
L180:     * `github` - prints GitHub Annotation warnings right in the Pull Request. Supposed to be used with GitHub Actions. See cite40†`--logger-github` , but usually not necessary as it is automatically detected.
L181:     * `gitlab` - GitLab (Code Climate) code quality report. Can be processed as a `codequality` report artifact in Gitlab.
L182:     * `summaryJson` - machine-readable file in JSON format like `json` but containing only general stats. Can be programmatically analyzed, for example on CI.
L183:   * `tmpDir` - Optional. It’s a folder where Infection creates its configs, caches and other stuff. It may be useful for people who doesn’t have access to the default system temporary folder and/or doesn’t have write permissions. Either absolute `/tmp/folder` or relative `var/cache` paths can be used.
L184:   * `phpUnit` - optional key
L185:     * `configDir` - custom directory path with `phpunit.xml.dist` file. This is useful for example for old Symfony app, where `phpunit.xml.dist` is located at `./app`
L186:     * `customPath` - custom path to PHPUnit executable. This is useful when you run tests by external shared phar file that is located outside project root. Relative paths are relative to the configuration file.
L187:   * `phpStan` - optional key
L188:     * `configDir` - custom directory path with `phpstan.neon.dist` file.
L189:     * `customPath` - custom path to PHPStan executable. This is useful when you run static analysis by external shared phar file that is located outside project root. Relative paths are relative to the configuration file.
L190:   * `mago` - optional key
L191:     * `configDir` - custom directory path with `mago.toml` file.
L192:     * `customPath` - custom path to mago executable. This is useful when you run static analysis by external file that is located outside project root. Relative paths are relative to the configuration file.
L193:   * `ignoreMsiWithNoMutations` - optional key, whether to ignore MSI violations with zero mutations
L194:   * `minMsi` - optional key, a value for the Minimum Mutation Score Indicator (MSI) percentage value
L195:   * `minCoveredMsi` - optional key, a value for the Minimum Covered Code Mutation Score Indicator (MSI) percentage value
L196:   * `timeoutsAsEscaped` - optional key, treats timed-out mutants as escaped in MSI calculation, giving an honest picture of test quality. See cite41†`--with-timeouts` L197:   * `maxTimeouts` - optional key, maximum number of allowed timed-out mutants before the build fails. See cite42†`--max-timeouts` L198:   * `dotsPerRow` - optional key, number of dots per row in the dot progress formatter. Accepts a positive integer or the literal `"max"` to fit the terminal width. Defaults to `50`. See cite43†`--dots-per-row` L199:   * `mutators`: optional key, it contains the settings for different mutations and profiles, read more about it cite17†here L200:   * `testFramework`: optional key, it sets the framework to use for testing. Defaults to `phpunit`. This gets overridden by the `--test-framework` command line argument.
L201:   * `testFrameworkExtraArgs`: optional key, specifies additional arguments to pass to the test framework (e.g. enabling verbose mode). `--test-framework-extra-args` overrides this option.
L202:   * `testFrameworkOptions`: deprecated. Use `testFrameworkExtraArgs` or `--test-framework-extra-args`.
L203:   * `staticAnalysisTool`: optional key, enables static analysis integration to catch escaped mutants. Supports `"phpstan"` and `"mago"`. When enabled, Infection will run the static analysis tool on mutants that escape the test suite to identify additional issues like type violations, dead code, or unreachable paths. This helps improve mutation testing effectiveness by catching errors that tests might miss. Can be overridden by the `--static-analysis-tool` command line argument.
L204:   * `staticAnalysisToolOptions` optional key, it specifies additional options to pass to the static analysis tool (e.g. memory limit). `--static-analysis-tool-options` will override this option.
L205:   * `bootstrap`: optional key, use it to specify a file to include as part of the startup to pre-configure the Infection environment. Useful for adding custom autoloaders not included in composer.
L206:   * `initialTestsPhpOptions`: optional key, specify additional php options for the initial test (IE: Enabling X-Debug). `--initial-tests-php-options` will override this option.

L208: #### How to use custom autoloader or bootstrap file cite44†​ L209: 
L210: If you have a custom autoloader or bootstrap file for your application, you should tell Infection about it.
L211: 
L212: For example, you have

L228: ## Running Infection cite45†​ L229:

L572:     Tests: 2, Assertions: 2, Deprecations: 1, Warnings: 1.
L573: `--fail-on-all-issues` and its XML configuration file counterpart, `failOnAllIssues="true"`, take precedence over the fine-grained `failOn*` attributes of the XML configuration file: configuring a fine-grained `failOn*` attribute to `false` has no effect when `failOnAllIssues` is configured to `true`.
L574: The fine-grained `--fail-on-*` options have `--do-not-fail-on-*` counterparts that can be used to override settings from the XML configuration file. A `--do-not-fail-on-*` option disables failing on the respective issue type and takes precedence over all `--fail-on-*` options and `failOn*` attributes, including `--fail-on-all-issues` and `failOnAllIssues="true"`. The `--do-not-fail-on-*` options are therefore the only way to not fail on a specific issue type when `failOnAllIssues="true"` is configured.
L575: For deprecations, the failure behaviour can be refined based on how a deprecation was triggered. The `--fail-on-self-deprecation`, `--fail-on-direct-deprecation`, and `--fail-on-indirect-deprecation` options (and their `--do-not-fail-on-*` counterparts) control the exit code separately for each trigger type. See cite51†Failing on deprecations based on how they are triggered for details.
L576: 
L577: See cite52†Execution for the complete reference.
L578: ## Stopping earlycite53† L579: 
L580: When a test suite is large, it can be useful to stop execution as soon as a problem is encountered instead of waiting for the entire suite to finish.
L581: 
L582: The `--stop-on-*` family of options controls this:
L583: 
L584:   * `--stop-on-defect[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) error, failure, warning, or risky test
L585: 
L586:   * `--stop-on-error[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) error
L587: 
L588:   * `--stop-on-failure[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) failure
L589:   * `--stop-on-warning[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) warning
L590: 
L591:   * `--stop-on-risky[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) risky test
L592: 
L593:   * `--stop-on-deprecation[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) deprecation
L594: 
L595:   * `--stop-on-notice[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) notice
L596: 
L597:   * `--stop-on-skipped[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) skipped test
L598: 
L599:   * `--stop-on-incomplete[=<n>]` stops after the first (or n-th) incomplete test
L600: When used without a value, these options stop execution after the first occurrence. When a threshold `n` is specified (for example, `--stop-on-failure=3`), execution continues until `n` occurrences have been encountered.
L601: 
L602: See cite52†Execution for the complete reference.
L603: ## Limiting the duration of the test runcite54† L604: 
L605: The `--timeout <sec>` option sets a wall-clock limit, in seconds, for the entire test run:
L606: 
L607:     $ ./tools/phpunit --timeout 300
L608: The clock starts as soon as the configuration is known, so bootstrapping and loading the test suite count toward the limit. The limit is checked whenever a test has finished; no PHP extension is required for this. When the limit is exceeded, no further tests are started and the run ends the way a run that was stopped by a `--stop-on-*` option ends: the configured logs are written, the result is printed, and a message states that the time limit was exceeded.
L609: When the `pcntl` extension is available, a test that is still running when the limit is exceeded is aborted. It is reported as an error whose stack trace shows where the test was stuck:
L610: 
L611:     $ ./tools/phpunit --timeout 300
L612:     PHPUnit 13.4.0 by Sebastian Bergmann and contributors.
L613: 
L614:     Runtime:       PHP 8.5.5
L615:     Configuration: /path/to/project/phpunit.xml
L616: 
L617:     .......E
L618: 
L619:     The time limit of 300 seconds for the test run was exceeded.
L620: 
L621:     Time: 05:00.012, Memory: 12.00 MB
L622:     There was 1 error:
L623: 
L624:     1) ExampleTest::testSomething
L625:     PHPUnit\Runner\TimeLimit\TimeLimitExceededException: This test was aborted because the time limit of 300 seconds for the test run was exceeded
L626: 
L627:     /path/to/tests/ExampleTest.php:47
L628: 
L629:     ERRORS!
L630:     Tests: 8, Assertions: 7, Errors: 1.
L631: Without the `pcntl` extension, the test that is running when the limit is exceeded is not aborted. The test run stops after it has finished. The same applies to tests that run in a separate process (see cite55†RunInSeparateProcess ) and to PHPT tests, regardless of whether `pcntl` is available.
L632: The shell exit code of a run that exceeded its time limit is `124`, the value that GNU `timeout(1)` uses for a command that exceeded its time limit, regardless of whether the tests that did run passed (see cite56†Exit codes ). Code coverage reports and the baseline are not generated for such a run, as for a run that was interrupted by a signal. The `PHPUnit\Event\TestRunner\TimeLimitExceeded` event (see cite57†Events ) is emitted when the limit is exceeded.
L633: `--timeout` limits the test run as a whole, whereas `--enforce-time-limit` limits individual tests based on their size (see cite58†Test Execution Timeout ). The two options can be combined.
L634: `--timeout` is intended for situations in which PHPUnit is invoked without a person watching the run, for instance by a CI pipeline or by an AI-based coding assistant. Such a caller cannot tell a hung test run from a long one. Without a time limit, its only option is to kill the process, which leaves it without a summary, an exit code, a log file, or any record of which test was running. With `--timeout`, the run ends on its own with all of these.
L635: ## Loggingcite59† L636: 
L637: PHPUnit can write test results to log files in various formats:
L638: 
L639:   * `--log-otr <file>` writes test results in Open Test Reporting (OTR) XML format (recommended)
L640: 
L641:   * `--log-junit <file>` writes test results in JUnit XML format (legacy)
L642: 
L643:   * `--log-teamcity <file>` writes test results in TeamCity format (used by PhpStorm)
L644: 
L645:   * `--testdox-html <file>` writes test results in TestDox format as an HTML file
L646:   * `--testdox-text <file>` writes test results in TestDox format as a plain text file
L647: 
L648:   * `--log-events-text <file>` writes all test runner events as plain text
L649: 
L650:   * `--log-events-verbose-text <file>` writes all test runner events with extended information
L651: 
L652: These logfiles are commonly used for CI tool integration and reporting.
L653: The `--testdox-html` and `--testdox-text` options write a report to a file; they are not intended to replace or augment the console output. For TestDox-formatted console output use `--testdox` (see cite60†TestDox ).
L654: 
L655: Logging can also be configured in the XML configuration file (see cite61†The <logging> Element ).
L656: 
L657: The `--no-logging` option ignores all logging configured in the XML configuration file.
L658: ## Test execution ordercite62† L659: 
L660: By default, PHPUnit executes the tests of each test suite in the order in which it discovered them. The `--order-by` option changes that: it configures a pipeline of reordering stages that is applied to the tests of every test suite, one stage after another.
L661: ### Ordercite63† L662: 
L663: The order is the first stage of the pipeline. Exactly one order can be configured:
L664: 
L665: `default`
L666: 
L667: > Tests are executed in the order in which they were discovered
L668: 
L669: `duration-ascending`
L670: 
L671: > Tests are ordered by duration, fastest test first. This requires the test run history (enabled by default, see `--record-test-run-history`)
L672: 
L673: `duration-descending`
L674: 
L675: > Tests are ordered by duration, slowest test first. This requires the test run history
L676: 
L677: `modified-ascending`
L678: > Tests are ordered by the time their source files were last modified, least recently modified test first
L679: 
L680: `modified-descending`
L681: 
L682: > Tests are ordered by the time their source files were last modified, most recently modified test first
L683: 
L684: `random`
L685: 
L686: > Tests are executed in random order. Use `--random-order-seed` to make the order reproducible
L687: 
L688: `reverse`
L689: 
L690: > Tests are executed in reverse discovery order
L691: 
L692: `size-ascending`
L693: 
L694: > Tests are ordered by size (small, medium, large, unknown)
L695: 
L696: `size-descending`
L697: > Tests are ordered by size in reverse (large, medium, small, unknown)
L698: ### Ordering by modification timecite64† L699: 
L700: `--order-by modified-descending` runs the tests you have worked on most recently first. Combined with `--stop-on-failure`, this shortens the feedback loop while a new test is being written.
L701: The source files of a test are the files a change to which can change what the test does: the file that declares the test class, the files that declare the classes it extends, and the files that declare the traits any of them use. The most recent modification among them decides, so modifying a base test class or a trait moves every test class that uses it to the front as well. For a PHPT test, the `.phpt` file is the test. A test suite is as new as the newest test it contains.
L702: 
L703: Note
L704: The modification time of a file is not a record of who changed what: checking out a branch, cloning a repository, installing dependencies, and copying or deploying files all set it to the time of that operation. On a continuous integration server, where every file is usually written at the same time, this order is therefore meaningless. It is intended for local development and should not be configured in a project’s XML configuration file.
"}

name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  COMPOSER_NO_INTERACTION: '1'
  DOCS_BRANCH: gh-pages

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Generate and publish the documentation site
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: '8.5'
          extensions: mbstring, pcntl, gd
          coverage: pcov

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer install --working-dir="$dir" --no-interaction --prefer-dist
          done

      - name: Check installed platform requirements
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer check-platform-reqs --working-dir="$dir"
          done

      - name: Restore the DocGen cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9
        with:
          path: build/docgen-cache
          key: docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/*/composer.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/*/composer.lock') }}-
            docgen-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Generate the coverage report the site reads
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for dir in packages/*; do
            composer --working-dir="$dir" test:coverage
          done

      - name: Generate the documentation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          repository="$(printf '%s' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
          php packages/docgen-php/bin/docgen --packages=packages/* --exclude='*/tests/Fixture/*' --base-url="https://${repository%%/*}.github.io/${repository#*/}"

      - name: Check out the documentation branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.DOCS_BRANCH }}
          path: .docs-branch

      - name: Publish the site
        working-directory: .docs-branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          rsync -a --checksum --delete --exclude '/.git/' --exclude '/pr/' --exclude '/CNAME' ../build/docs/ ./

          git add --all
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "The ${DOCS_BRANCH} branch already serves this documentation."
            exit 0
          fi

          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' \
            -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' \
            commit --message "docs: generate from ${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git push origin "HEAD:${DOCS_BRANCH}"
name: Context7

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  refresh:
    name: Refresh the Context7 library
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Request a refresh of the indexed documentation
        env:
          CONTEXT7_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONTEXT7_API_KEY }}
          LIBRARY_NAME: /${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ -z "${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" ]; then
            echo '::error::The CONTEXT7_API_KEY repository secret is not set. Copy the key from https://context7.com/dashboard into Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions.'
            exit 1
          fi

          response_file="$(mktemp)"
          status="$(curl --silent --show-error --output "${response_file}" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
            --request POST https://context7.com/api/v1/refresh \
            --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" \
            --data "{\"libraryName\": \"${LIBRARY_NAME}\"}")"
          echo "HTTP ${status}: $(cat "${response_file}")"

          if [ "${status}" = '200' ]; then
            exit 0
          fi

          error_code="$(jq -r '.error // empty' "${response_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ "${status}" = '400' ] && [ "${error_code}" = 'too-early' ]; then
            echo "::notice::Context7 declined the refresh of ${LIBRARY_NAME} because its minimum interval since the last update has not passed. The next push after that interval refreshes the library."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "::error::Context7 rejected the refresh of ${LIBRARY_NAME} with HTTP ${status}. Check the response above: 401 means the CONTEXT7_API_KEY secret is wrong, 404 means the library is not registered under that name."
          exit 1

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Mutation;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Toolkit\Mutation\MutationContract;
use Toolkit\Mutation\MutationContractReader;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\PhpDoc\RulePhpDocParser;

/**
 * @covers \Toolkit\Mutation\MutationContractReader
 */
#[CoversClass(MutationContractReader::class)]
#[UsesClass(MutationContract::class)]
#[UsesClass(RulePhpDocParser::class)]
final class MutationContractReaderTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReadCollectsParameterReceiverAndGlobalEffects(): void
    {
        $node = (new RulePhpDocParser())->parse(<<<'DOC'
/**
 * @param object $value +mut updated value
 * @mutation $this, global
 */
DOC);
        $contract = (new MutationContractReader())->read($node);

        self::assertTrue($contract->mutatesParameter('value'));
        self::assertTrue($contract->mutatesThis());
        self::assertTrue($contract->mutatesGlobal());
        self::assertSame([], $contract->problems());
    }

    public function testReadReportsMisplacedAndUnknownSyntax(): void
    {
        $node = (new RulePhpDocParser())->parse(<<<'DOC'
/**
 * @param object $value prose +mut
 * @mutation cache
 */
DOC);

        self::assertCount(2, (new MutationContractReader())->read($node)->problems());
    }

    public function testIsMutableDescriptionRequiresTheLeadingExactToken(): void
    {
        $reader = new MutationContractReader();

        self::assertTrue($reader->isMutableDescription('+mut changed'));
        self::assertFalse($reader->isMutableDescription('changed +mut'));
        self::assertFalse($reader->isMutableDescription('+mutable'));
    }

    public function testCleanDescriptionRemovesOnlyTheMarker(): void
    {
        $reader = new MutationContractReader();

        self::assertSame('changed value', $reader->cleanDescription('+mut changed value'));
        self::assertSame('ordinary prose', $reader->cleanDescription('ordinary prose'));
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\Mutation;

use function array_keys;
use function array_map;
use function explode;
use function ltrim;

use PHPStan\PhpDocParser\Ast\PhpDoc\ParamTagValueNode;
use PHPStan\PhpDocParser\Ast\PhpDoc\PhpDocNode;

use function preg_match;
use function preg_replace;
use function str_contains;
use function trim;

/**
 * Reads the toolkit's compact mutation syntax from a PHPDoc syntax tree.
 */
final class MutationContractReader
{
    /**
     * The exact token accepted at the start of a parameter description.
     */
    public const PARAMETER_MARKER = '+mut';

    /**
     * Reads parameter markers and callable mutation targets.
     */
    public function read(PhpDocNode $node): MutationContract
    {
        $parameters = [];
        $problems = [];
        foreach (['@param', '@psalm-param', '@phpstan-param'] as $tagName) {
            foreach ($node->getTagsByName($tagName) as $tag) {
                if (!$tag->value instanceof ParamTagValueNode) {
                    continue;
                }

                $name = ltrim($tag->value->parameterName, '$');
                if ($this->isMutableDescription($tag->value->description)) {
                    $parameters[$name] = true;
                } elseif (str_contains($tag->value->description, self::PARAMETER_MARKER)) {
                    $problems[] = 'Place +mut immediately after ' . $tag->value->parameterName . ' in the @param tag.';
                }
            }
        }

        $thisTarget = false;
        $globalTarget = false;
        foreach ($node->getTagsByName('@mutation') as $tag) {
            $value = trim((string) $tag->value);
            if ($value === '') {
                $problems[] = 'Give @mutation one or both targets: $this or global.';

                continue;
            }

            foreach (array_map('trim', explode(',', $value)) as $target) {
                if ($target === '$this') {
                    $thisTarget = true;
                } elseif ($target === 'global') {
                    $globalTarget = true;
                } else {
                    $problems[] = 'Replace @mutation target "' . $target . '" with $this or global.';
                }
            }
        }

        return new MutationContract(array_keys($parameters), $thisTarget, $globalTarget, $problems);
    }

    /**
     * Reports whether a parameter description starts with the exact marker.
     */
    public function isMutableDescription(string $description): bool
    {
        return preg_match('/^\+mut(?:\s+|$)/', trim($description)) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * Removes the marker before prose is shown as the parameter description.
     */
    public function cleanDescription(string $description): string
    {
        $description = trim($description);
        if (!$this->isMutableDescription($description)) {
            return $description;
        }

        return trim((string) preg_replace('/^\+mut(?:\s+|$)/', '', $description, 1));
    }
}

/**

final class MutationContractReader
{
    /**
     * The exact token accepted at the start of a parameter description.
     */
    public const PARAMETER_MARKER = '+mut';

    /**
     * Reads parameter markers and callable mutation targets.

    public function read(PhpDocNode $node): MutationContract
    {
        $parameters = [];
        $problems = [];
        foreach (['@param', '@psalm-param', '@phpstan-param'] as $tagName) {
            foreach ($node->getTagsByName($tagName) as $tag) {
                if (!$tag->value instanceof ParamTagValueNode) {

                }

                $name = ltrim($tag->value->parameterName, '$');
                if ($this->isMutableDescription($tag->value->description)) {
                    $parameters[$name] = true;
                } elseif (str_contains($tag->value->description, self::PARAMETER_MARKER)) {
                    $problems[] = 'Place +mut immediately after ' . $tag->value->parameterName . ' in the @param tag.';
                }
            }
        }

        $thisTarget = false;
        $globalTarget = false;
        foreach ($node->getTagsByName('@mutation') as $tag) {
            $value = trim((string) $tag->value);
            if ($value === '') {
                $problems[] = 'Give @mutation one or both targets: $this or global.';

                continue;
            }

            foreach (array_map('trim', explode(',', $value)) as $target) {
                if ($target === '$this') {
                    $thisTarget = true;
                } elseif ($target === 'global') {
                    $globalTarget = true;
                } else {
                    $problems[] = 'Replace @mutation target "' . $target . '" with $this or global.';
                }
            }
        }

        return new MutationContract(array_keys($parameters), $thisTarget, $globalTarget, $problems);
    }

    /**
     * Reports whether a parameter description starts with the exact marker.
     */
    public function isMutableDescription(string $description): bool
    {
        return preg_match('/^\+mut(?:\s+|$)/', trim($description)) === 1;
    }

    /**
     * Removes the marker before prose is shown as the parameter description.
     */
    public function cleanDescription(string $description): string
    {
        $description = trim($description);
        if (!$this->isMutableDescription($description)) {
            return $description;
        }

        return trim((string) preg_replace('/^\+mut(?:\s+|$)/', '', $description, 1));
    }
}
